title: Start from nothing
goal: q reads, at each clock, what d was the clock before, as in One clock late. But here a register starts at x -- nothing has told it a value yet -- and rst is 1 on the first clock and on the last. Whenever rst is 1, q must read 0 at once, whatever d was: give the register a reset.
hint: x is a value too: it means nobody knows. A reset says what a register holds, and need not wait for the clock to say it.
